title.zh: NBA Embraces the CFTC on Prediction Markets as the NFL Fights It in Court
title.en: NBA Embraces the CFTC on Prediction Markets as the NFL Fights It in Court

current_state.zh: The NBA signed a memorandum of understanding with the CFTC to share information and police integrity issues such as insider trading and fraud in basketball prediction markets, aligning with MLB and NHL as the NFL contests the regulator's authority over event contracts.
current_state.en: The NBA signed a memorandum of understanding with the CFTC to share information and police integrity issues such as insider trading and fraud in basketball prediction markets, aligning with MLB and NHL as the NFL contests the regulator's authority over event contracts.
